howididit.tools: M-Audio Keystudio, Fender Twin Reverb, Boss Drum Machine, Fender Telecaster, Korg AGX-1000, Reaper, SM-58
howididit.samples: Stefsax's Vroum, Vroum and fourstone's Funk Construction Kit.
howididit.origial: The vocal, two wah wah guitar tracks, the organ, the drums.
howididit.process:
Brought in Victor's guitar and bass and stretched it out to 4 mins. or so I bringing it in a second time. Put Victor's guitar part through a Fender Twin reverb to vintage it up a little.

Brought in Stefsax's bariphone-like Sax part, changed the pitch from Bb to C, and changed the tempo from 120 to 104. Chopped it up and placed the ba-dup line on the one for three bars, with some extra notes on every fourth.

Took his Alto solo, did the same pitch and tempo shift, and pasted an extra couple of lines onto the end to get it to fit the break.

Added a rhythm wah-wah, and then a lead using the Korg expression pedal.

Then I wrote a lyric and sang until my voice was raw!
howididit.other: This was actually my main style of music making - vintage soul - for about twenty years. Surprisingly, I haven't done much of it at CCMixter, so I'm glad to get something up that represents such a big part of my background.

Like Icarus’ shame

I’ve got to burn with you all tonight

Gotta tease you

I’ve got to burn with you all tonight

Can you show me, 
Can you teach me
What a woman can be?
You possess me
and arrest me
Baby, read me my rights
Must be illegal what I’m feelin’ tonight

Don’t you know you set me on fire
I’ve got to burn with you all tonight
Light me on fire!

upload_description_plain:
Today I walked from my home across town to the public library. I carried with me my Swift Audubon binoculars. I saw three kestrel.
Kestrel are small, lovely birds of prey. One kestrel descended from telephone pole to ground with a fluttery, graceful, abandoned motion--perhaps causing an untimely end for a bug or rodent, but also giving birth to this song.
